semantics.queue: Actual ordered services are retained; service sum equals used for every think.
semantics.search: Exact per-plan work/expansions/depth/limitReason; no sum of cumulative expansions.
semantics.scope: Reported plan counters and the actual total queue ledger are separate; not added together.
semantics.operation: Read-only extraction; no planning, geometry queries, simulation or source changes.

byServiceReviewProjection.semantics: All full service IDs and work remain in the immutable artifact and per-think records. This review projection retains totals/byTier/first/final and avoids generated multi-megabyte unique cache keys.
All full service IDs and work remain in the immutable artifact and per-think records. This review projection retains totals/byTier/first/final and avoids generated multi-megabyte unique cache keys.

refinement.semantics: Known memory, known node annotation, exact selected declaration and output-ready are distinct observations. Firsts refer to any selected action of that kind; full original IDs/declarations/source revisions remain in per-think records. Runtime memory publication is reported only when original memoryAfter is present; older frames without retained memory stay missing. No planning, simulation or geometry query is executed.

model.semantics: Actual output.campModelUsage counters only, not an independent model invocation. Sums count quote observations/calls in recorded outputs, not battles or unique samples. Missing output field stays missing. Selected/alternative clear-camp quote fields retain original duration/cost/P/reasons; full declarations remain in the original frames.
